choosePortDescription: You are assigned to multiple ports. Select one to continue.
ssoLegacyHubHint: To sign in with SSO, open Jetty from Downstream Hub.

ssoError.title: Sign-in could not continue
ssoError.fallback: Single sign-on could not be completed. Try again from Downstream Hub, or sign in with your username and password.
ssoError.oidc_disabled: Single sign-on via Dws Hub is not enabled on this server. Open Jetty from Downstream Hub, or sign in with your username and password below.
ssoError.legacy_bridge_disabled: Legacy SSO is disabled on this server. Use the Sign in via Dws Hub button on the login page, or sign in with your username and password.
ssoError.sso_not_configured: Single sign-on is not configured on this server. Contact your administrator, or sign in with your username and password.
ssoError.missing_token: The SSO request did not include a sign-in token. Open Jetty from Downstream Hub and try again.
ssoError.invalid_token: The SSO token is invalid or has expired. Open Jetty from Downstream Hub and try again.
ssoError.missing_email_claim: The SSO token did not include an email address. Open Jetty from Downstream Hub and try again.
ssoError.inactive_user: Your Jetty account is inactive. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.no_account_jit_disabled: No Jetty account exists for this email. Ask an administrator to create your user, or enable automatic provisioning.
ssoError.server_config_error: The server SSO configuration is incomplete. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.server_config_error_role: The server SSO role configuration is incomplete. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.sign_on_failed: Sign-on failed. Try again from Downstream Hub, or sign in with your username and password.
ssoError.invalid_state: The sign-in session expired or was invalid. Start again from the login page or Downstream Hub.
ssoError.missing_code: The authorization response was incomplete. Start sign-in again from Downstream Hub.
ssoError.missing_id_token: Sign-in with Dws Hub could not be completed. Try again from Downstream Hub.
ssoError.connect_sso_email_not_verified: Your Hub email is not verified. Complete Hub verification (magic link), then try linking SSO again.
ssoError.domain_not_allowed: Your email domain is not allowed for SSO on this server. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.connect_sso_requires_session: Sign in locally first, then connect SSO from your account settings.
ssoError.connect_sso_user_not_found: Your account could not be found or is inactive. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.connect_sso_email_mismatch: Your Hub account email does not match your Jetty account. Use matching accounts or contact your administrator.
ssoError.connect_sso_sub_collision: This Hub identity is already linked to another Jetty user. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.admin_prelink_email_not_verified: The Hub email is not verified. Complete Hub verification (magic link), then use the link again.
ssoError.admin_prelink_state_invalid: The admin SSO link is invalid or expired. Ask an administrator to generate a new link.
ssoError.admin_prelink_email_mismatch: The Hub account email does not match the target user. Ask an administrator to regenerate the link.
ssoError.admin_prelink_target_missing: The target user was not found or is inactive. Ask an administrator to check the account.
ssoError.admin_prelink_target_email_changed: The target user's email has changed. Ask an administrator to regenerate the SSO link.
ssoError.admin_prelink_sub_collision: This Hub identity is already linked to another Jetty user. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.ambiguous_email_match: Multiple Jetty accounts share this email. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.email_not_verified: Your Hub email is not verified. Complete Hub verification (magic link), then try again.
ssoError.oidc_sub_collision: This Hub identity is already linked to another Jetty user. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.email_collision_local_account: Your SSO account is not linked to Jetty yet. Contact your administrator to link your SSO identity.
ssoError.jit_missing_email: SSO sign-in requires an email address from Dws Hub. Contact your administrator if this persists.
ssoError.jit_email_not_verified: Your Hub email is not verified. Complete Hub verification (magic link), then try again.
ssoError.no_linked_sso_user: No linked SSO account was found for this identity. Contact your administrator.
ssoError.oidc_sign_in_failed: Sign-in with Dws Hub failed. Try again from Downstream Hub, or sign in with your username and password.
